meaning.en: (computer science) Describing a set for which there exists an algorithm that will determine whether any element is or is not within the set in a finite amount of time.

meaning.en: (logic) In intuitionistic logic, a proposition P is decidable in a given theory if it can be proven from the theory that "either P or not P", i.e. in symbols: .
meaning.vi: (logic) Trong logic trực giác, mệnh đề P có thể xác định được trong một lý thuyết đã cho nếu nó có thể được chứng minh từ lý thuyết rằng ""hoặc P hoặc không phải P"", tức là trong các ký hiệu:.

sentences.en: Description Logics(DLs) is a decidable subset of first-order predication logic which possesses powerful function of knowledge expressing and reasoning.

sentences.en: Reasoners for OWL DL, while dealing with a decidable sublanguage, will be subject to higher worst-case complexity.

sentences.en: The restricted set of terms, becomes decidable , and moreover can be implemented very efficiently.

sentences.en: You can validate absolutely any string that conforms to any decidable set of rules.

sentences.en: The first-order theory of a complete binary tree is decidable by the quantifier elimination,(http://sentencedict.com/decidable.html) we also know the CB rank of elements of a complete binary tree.

sentences.en: In contrast in intensional Type Theory type checking is decidable, but the representation of many mathematical concepts is non-standard due to a lack of extensional reasoning.

sentences.en: Their algorithm to find extensions is considered to be more efficient than the existing reconstruction procedure, and it is decidable .

sentences.en: Secondly, economy based on knowledge and technology, the economic benefit will drive knowledge and technology so that to become the decidable factors of development.
